title: Juicy Smoky Polish Sausage Kebabs
description: A garlicky and springy Polish dish featuring sun-dried tomatoes and char-grill flavor, perfect for a midnight craving.

ingredients.name: sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the Polish sausage, sun-dried tomatoes, onion, and bell pepper to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the sausage and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausage is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sun-dried tomatoes and garlic if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze leftovers for later use.
